frozen_claims_to_test.local_state_function_rule: s1 is a local background state-function slope and cannot be chosen separately for each Fourier k

interpretation_if_pass: A local nonlinear alpha6(X) state-function with one background slope s1 cannot cancel the archived soft-s cubic vertex over any finite k interval: the required magnitude 3H/(2 omega(k)) is strictly k-dependent for positive finite scales, while |1-2s1| is k-independent on a fixed background. The archived special completion s1=1/2 also cannot cancel because the required magnitude is positive. This does not yet include the full reduced shift-exchange contribution.
